name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav Novák's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, through his keen eye for detail honed during his early years as a precision instrument maker. He quickly transitioned to automotive engineering, specializing in quality control, where his meticulous nature proved invaluable. Before joining Racing Bulls, Jaroslav spent over a decade ensuring the reliability of components for a prominent Czech automotive manufacturer, a role that instilled in him a relentless pursuit of perfection.

At Racing Bulls, Jaroslav is renowned for his unwavering commitment to quality and his innovative approach to problem-solving. He sees his role not just as identifying flaws but as proactively seeking ways to improve processes and prevent future issues. His dedication to maintaining the highest standards ensures that every component leaving his department is ready to withstand the rigors of competitive racing. He strives to foster a culture of continuous improvement within his team, always encouraging them to challenge conventional thinking.

Jaroslav's unique blend of technical expertise and management skills, coupled with his unyielding loyalty, makes him an indispensable asset to the Racing Bulls team. His deep understanding of the intricate details of the car's mechanical systems, and his ability to identify potential issues before they become critical, have saved the team valuable time and resources on numerous occasions.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown, greying at the temples
physical.description: A stocky man with a serious demeanor, Jaroslav always wears a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on personally inspecting the first component off the production line each morning.
